items.description: Signed OL Kohl Levao to the active roster. Signed CB Jordan Clark and K Blake Grupe to the practice squad. Released S John Saunders Jr from the practice squad.
Signed LB Anfernee Orji to the practice squad. Placed LB Chance Campbell on practice squad injured reserve.
Designated RB Zach Charbonnet to return from the PUP list.
Signed LB Brian Asamoah to the practice squad.
Re-signed DL Phidarian Mathis to the practice squad.
Designated DB Kyler Gordon to return from the PUP list.
Signed WR Ke'Shawn Williams to the practice squad.

Signed DT Elijah Garcia from the practice squad to the active roster. Placed S Jalen Thompson and DT Jonathan Bullard on injured reserve. Signed DB Alex Austin, DB Tyrek Funderburk and DB Juanyeh Thomas to the practice squad.
Signed LB Amen Ogbongbemiga from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed WR Lawrence Keys to the practice squad.
Signed G Kevin Zeitler. Placed WR Jayden Reed on injured reserve. Signed DT David Blay and WR Coleman Owen to the practice squad.
Signed RB Owen Wright to the practice squad.

Signed T Da'Metrius Weatherspoon to the practice squad.
Released NT Josh Tupou. Signed QB Jake Haener to the practice squad.
Signed DT Gabe Hall to the practice squad.
Signed DE Myles Adams to the practice squad.
Signed WR Dante Pettis to the practice squad.
Signed LB Jimmy Ciarlo and DT Gary Smith to the practice squad. Released DB D'Anthony Bell and WR Julian Hicks from the practice squad.
Signed DB Ifeatu Melifonwu from the practice squad to the active roster. Placed WR Jalen McMillan on injured reserve. Signed QB Brett Rypien to the practice squad.
Signed DE Charles Snowden to the practice squad.

Signed WR David Moore and RB Anthony Tyus from the practice squad to the active roster. Placed CB Jaycee Horn and CB Michael Jackson on injured reserve. Waived LB Claudin Cherelus from injured reserve with an injury settlement. Signed DB Robert Rochell to the practice squad.
Signed S K'Von Wallace from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed C Andre James and G Kyle Hergel to the practice squad.

Signed LB Chris Braswell from the practice squad to the active roster. Placed DL Mario Edwards on injured reserve. Signed DT Aaron Graves, LB Caleb Johnson and WR Treyvhon Saunders to the practice squad. Released WR Bryce Oliver from the practice squad.
